47	    """Extract 3D patches from 4D DWI data.
48	
49	    Parameters
50	    ----------
51	    arr : ndarray
52	        The 4D noisy DWI data to be denoised.
53	    patch_radius : int or array of shape (3,)
54	        The radius of the local patch to be taken around each voxel (in
55	        voxels).
56	
57	    Returns
58	    -------
59	    all_patches : ndarray
60	        All 3D patches flattened out to be 2D corresponding to the each 3D
61	        volume of the 4D DWI data.
62	
63	    """
64	    patch_radius = np.asarray(patch_radius, dtype=int)
65	    if patch_radius.size == 1:
66	        patch_radius = np.repeat(patch_radius, 3)
67	    elif patch_radius.size != 3:
68	        raise ValueError("patch_radius should have length 1 or 3")
69	
70	    patch_size = 2 * patch_radius + 1
71	    dim = arr.shape[-1]
72	
73	    # Calculate the shape of the output array
74	    output_shape = tuple(arr.shape[i] - 2 * patch_radius[i] for i in range(3))
75	    total_patches = np.prod(output_shape)
76	
77	    patches = sliding_window_view(arr, tuple(patch_size) + (dim,))
78	
79	    # Reshape and transpose the patches to match the original function's output shape
80	    all_patches = patches.reshape(total_patches, np.prod(patch_size), dim)
81	    all_patches = all_patches.transpose(2, 1, 0)
82	
83	    return np.array(all_patches)

86	def _fit_denoising_model(train, vol_idx, model, alpha):
87	    """Fit a single 3D volume using a train and test phase.
88	
89	    Parameters
90	    ----------
91	    train : ndarray
92	        Array of all 3D patches flattened out to be 2D.
93	    vol_idx : int
94	        The volume number that needs to be held out for training.
95	    model : str or sklearn.base.RegressorMixin
96	        This will determine the algorithm used to solve the set of linear
97	        equations underlying this model. If it is a string it needs to be
98	        one of the following: {'ols', 'ridge', 'lasso'}. Otherwise,
99	        it can be an object that inherits from
100	        `dipy.optimize.SKLearnLinearSolver` or an object with a similar
101	        interface from Scikit-Learn:
102	        `sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression`,
103	        `sklearn.linear_model.Lasso` or `sklearn.linear_model.Ridge`
104	        and other objects that inherit from `sklearn.base.RegressorMixin`.
105	    alpha : float
106	        Regularization parameter only for ridge and lasso regression models.
107	    version : int
108	        Version 1 or 3 of Patch2Self to use.
109	
110	    Returns
111	    -------
112	    model_instance : fitted linear model object
113	        The fitted model instance if version is 3.
114	    cur_x : ndarray
115	        The patches corresponding to all volumes except the held out volume.
116	
117	    """
118	    if isinstance(model, str):
119	        if model.lower() == "ols":
120	            model_instance = linear_model.Ridge(copy_X=False, alpha=1e-10)
121	        elif model.lower() == "ridge":
122	            model_instance = linear_model.Ridge(copy_X=False, alpha=alpha)
123	        elif model.lower() == "lasso":
124	            model_instance = linear_model.Lasso(copy_X=False, max_iter=50, alpha=alpha)
125	        else:
126	            raise ValueError(
127	                f"Invalid model string: {model}. Should be 'ols', 'ridge', or 'lasso'."
128	            )
129	    elif isinstance(model, linear_model.BaseEstimator):
130	        model_instance = model
131	    else:

133	            "Model should either be a string or \
134	                an instance of sklearn.linear_model BaseEstimator."
135	        )

137	    model_instance.fit(cur_x.T, y.T)

141	def vol_denoise(
142	    data_dict, b0_idx, dwi_idx, model, alpha, b0_denoising, verbose, tmp_dir
143	):
144	    """Denoise a single 3D volume using train and test phase.
145	
146	    Parameters
147	    ----------
148	    data_dict : dict
149	        Dictionary containing the following:
150	            data_name : str
151	                The name of the memmap file containing the memmaped data.
152	            data_dtype : dtype
153	                The dtype of the data.
154	            data_shape : tuple
155	                The shape of the data.
156	            data_b0s : ndarray
157	                Array of all 3D patches flattened out to be 2D for b0 volumes.
158	            data_dwi : ndarray
159	                Array of all 3D patches flattened out to be 2D for dwi volumes.
160	    b0_idx : ndarray
161	        The indices of the b0 volumes.
162	    dwi_idx : ndarray
163	        The indices of the dwi volumes.
164	    model : sklearn.base.RegressorMixin
165	        This is the model that is initialized from the `_fit_denoising_model` function.
166	    alpha : float
167	        Regularization parameter only for ridge and lasso regression models.
168	    b0_denoising : bool
169	        Skips denoising b0 volumes if set to False.
170	    verbose : bool
171	        Show progress of Patch2Self and time taken.
172	    tmp_dir : str
173	        The directory to save the temporary files.
174	
175	    Returns
176	    -------
177	    denoised_arr.name : str
178	        The name of the memmap file containing the denoised array.
179	    denoised_arr.dtype : dtype
180	        The dtype of the denoised array.
181	    denoised_arr.shape : tuple
182	        The shape of the denoised array.
183	
184	    """
185	    data_shape = data_dict["data"][2]
186	    data_tmp = np.memmap(
187	        data_dict["data"][0],
188	        dtype=data_dict["data"][1],
189	        mode="r",
190	        shape=data_dict["data"][2],
191	    ).reshape(np.prod(data_shape[:-1]), data_shape[-1])
192	    data_b0s = data_dict["data_b0s"]
193	    data_dwi = data_dict["data_dwi"]
194	    p = data_tmp.shape[0] // 10
195	    b0_counter = 0
196	    dwi_counter = 0
197	    start_idx = 0
198	    denoised_arr_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
199	        delete=False, dir=tmp_dir, suffix="denoised_arr"
200	    )
201	    denoised_arr_file.close()
202	    denoised_arr = np.memmap(
203	        denoised_arr_file.name, dtype=data_tmp.dtype, mode="w+", shape=data_shape
204	    )
205	    idx_counter = 0
206	    full_result = np.empty(
207	        (data_shape[0], data_shape[1], data_shape[2], data_shape[3] // 5)
208	    )
209	    b0_idx = b0_idx
210	    dwi_idx = dwi_idx
211	    if data_b0s.shape[0] == 1:
212	        b0_denoising = False
213	    if not b0_denoising:
214	        if verbose:
215	            logger.info("b0 denoising skipped....")
216	    for vol_idx in tqdm(
217	        range(data_shape[-1]), desc="Fitting and Denoising", leave=False
218	    ):
219	        if vol_idx in b0_idx.flatten():
220	            if b0_denoising:
221	                b_fit, _ = _fit_denoising_model(data_b0s, b0_counter, model, alpha)
222	                b_matrix = np.zeros(data_tmp.shape[-1])
223	                b_fit_coef = np.insert(b_fit.coef_, b0_counter, 0)
224	                np.put(b_matrix, b0_idx, b_fit_coef)
225	                result = np.zeros(data_tmp.shape[0])
226	                for z in range(0, data_tmp.shape[0], p):
227	                    end_idx = z + p
228	                    if end_idx > z + p:
229	                        end_idx = data_tmp.shape[0]
230	                    result[z:end_idx] = (
231	                        np.matmul(np.squeeze(data_tmp[z:end_idx, :]), b_matrix)
232	                        + b_fit.intercept_
233	                    )
234	                full_result[..., idx_counter] = result.reshape(
235	                    data_shape[0], data_shape[1], data_shape[2]
236	                )
237	                idx_counter += 1
238	                b0_counter += 1
239	                del b_fit_coef
240	                del b_matrix
241	                del result
242	            else:
243	                full_result[..., idx_counter] = data_tmp[..., b0_counter].reshape(
244	                    data_shape[0], data_shape[1], data_shape[2]
245	                )
246	                b0_counter += 1
247	                idx_counter += 1
248	        else:
249	            dwi_fit, _ = _fit_denoising_model(data_dwi, dwi_counter, model, alpha)
250	            b_matrix = np.zeros(data_tmp.shape[-1])
251	            dwi_fit_coef = np.insert(dwi_fit.coef_, dwi_counter, 0)
252	            np.put(b_matrix, dwi_idx, dwi_fit_coef)
253	            del dwi_fit_coef
254	            result = np.zeros(data_tmp.shape[0])
255	            for z in range(0, data_tmp.shape[0], p):
256	                end_idx = z + p
257	                if end_idx > z + p:
258	                    end_idx = data_tmp.shape[0]
259	                result[z:end_idx] = (
260	                    np.matmul(np.squeeze(data_tmp[z:end_idx, :]), b_matrix)
261	                    + dwi_fit.intercept_
262	                )
263	            full_result[..., idx_counter] = result.reshape(
264	                data_shape[0], data_shape[1], data_shape[2]
265	            )
266	            idx_counter += 1
267	            dwi_counter += 1
268	        if idx_counter >= data_shape[-1] // 5:
269	            denoised_arr[..., start_idx : vol_idx + 1] = full_result
270	            start_idx = vol_idx + 1
271	            idx_counter = 0
272	    denoised_arr_idx = data_shape[-1] - data_shape[-1] % 5
273	    full_result_idx = full_result.shape[-1] - data_shape[-1] % 5
274	    denoised_arr[..., denoised_arr_idx:] = full_result[..., full_result_idx:]
275	    del full_result
276	    return denoised_arr_file.name, denoised_arr.dtype, denoised_arr.shape

387	def _validate_inputs(data, out_dtype, patch_radius, version, tmp_dir):
388	    """Validate inputs for patch2self function.
389	
390	    Parameters
391	    ----------
392	    data : ndarray
393	        The 4D noisy DWI data to be denoised.
394	    out_dtype : str or dtype
395	        The dtype for the output array.
396	    patch_radius : int or array of shape (3,)
397	        The radius of the local patch to be taken around each voxel (in
398	        voxels).
399	    version : int
400	        Version 1 or 3 of Patch2Self to use.
401	    tmp_dir : str
402	        The directory to save the temporary files. If None, the temporary
403	        files are saved in the system's default temporary directory.
404	
405	    Raises
406	    ------
407	    ValueError
408	        If temporary directory is not None for Patch2Self version 1.
409	        If the patch_radius is not 0 for Patch2Self version 3.
410	        If the temporary directory does not exist.
411	        If the input data is not a 4D array.
412	
413	    Warns
414	    -----
415	    If the input data has less than 10 3D volumes.
416	
417	    Returns
418	    -------
419	    out_dtype : str or dtype
420	        The dtype for the output array.
421	    tmp_dir : str
422	        The directory to save the temporary files. If None, the temporary
423	        files are saved in the system's default temporary directory.
424	
425	    """
426	    if out_dtype is None:
427	        out_dtype = data.dtype
428	
429	    if tmp_dir is None and version == 3:
430	        tmp_dir = tempfile.gettempdir()
431	
432	    if version not in [1, 3]:
433	        raise ValueError("Invalid version. Should be 1 or 3.")
434	
435	    if version == 1 and tmp_dir is not None:
436	        raise ValueError(
437	            "Temporary directory is not supported for Patch2Self version 1. \
438	                Please set tmp_dir to None."
439	        )
440	    if patch_radius != (0, 0, 0) and version == 3:
441	        raise ValueError(
442	            "Patch radius is not supported for Patch2Self version 3. \
443	                Please do not set patch_radius."
444	        )
445	
446	    if isinstance(patch_radius, list) and len(patch_radius) == 1:
447	        patch_radius = (patch_radius[0], patch_radius[0], patch_radius[0])
448	
449	    if isinstance(patch_radius, int):
450	        patch_radius = (patch_radius, patch_radius, patch_radius)
451	
452	    if version == 3 and tmp_dir is not None and not Path(tmp_dir).exists():
453	        raise ValueError("The temporary directory does not exist.")
454	    if data.ndim != 4:
455	        raise ValueError("Patch2Self can only denoise on 4D arrays.", data.shape)
456	    if data.shape[3] < 10:
457	        warn(
458	            "The input data has less than 10 3D volumes. \
459	                Patch2Self may not give optimal denoising performance.",
460	            stacklevel=2,
461	        )
462	
463	    return out_dtype, tmp_dir, patch_radius

466	def _patch2self_version1(
467	    data,
468	    bvals,
469	    patch_radius,
470	    model,
471	    b0_threshold,
472	    out_dtype,
473	    alpha,
474	    verbose,
475	    b0_denoising,
476	    clip_negative_vals,
477	    shift_intensity,
478	):
479	    """Patch2Self Denoiser.
480	
481	    Parameters
482	    ----------
483	    data : ndarray
484	        The 4D noisy DWI data to be denoised.
485	    bvals : array of shape (N,)
486	        Array of the bvals from the DWI acquisition.
487	    patch_radius : int or array of shape (3,)
488	        The radius of the local patch to be taken around each voxel (in
489	        voxels).
490	    model : string, or sklearn.base.RegressorMixin
491	        This will determine the algorithm used to solve the set of linear
492	        equations underlying this model. If it is a string it needs to be
493	        one of the following: {'ols', 'ridge', 'lasso'}. Otherwise,
494	        it can be an object that inherits from
495	        `dipy.optimize.SKLearnLinearSolver` or an object with a similar
496	        interface from Scikit-Learn:
497	        `sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression`,
498	        `sklearn.linear_model.Lasso` or `sklearn.linear_model.Ridge`
499	        and other objects that inherit from `sklearn.base.RegressorMixin`.
500	    b0_threshold : int
501	        Threshold for considering volumes as b0.
502	    out_dtype : str or dtype
503	        The dtype for the output array. Default: output has the same dtype as
504	        the input.
505	    alpha : float
506	        Regularization parameter only for ridge regression model.
507	    verbose : bool
508	        Show progress of Patch2Self and time taken.
509	    b0_denoising : bool
510	        Skips denoising b0 volumes if set to False.
511	    clip_negative_vals : bool
512	        Sets negative values after denoising to 0 using `np.clip`.
513	    shift_intensity : bool
514	        Shifts the distribution of intensities per volume to give
515	        non-negative values.
516	
517	    Returns
518	    -------
519	    denoised array : ndarray
520	        This is the denoised array of the same size as that of the input data,
521	        clipped to non-negative values.
522	    """
523	
524	    # We retain float64 precision, iff the input is in this precision:
525	    if data.dtype == np.float64:
526	        calc_dtype = np.float64
527	
528	    # Otherwise, we'll calculate things in float32 (saving memory)
529	    else:
530	        calc_dtype = np.float32
531	
532	    original_shape = data.shape
533	    if 1 in data.shape and data.shape[-1] != 1:
534	        position = data.shape.index(1)
535	        data = np.concatenate((data, data, data), position)
536	
537	    # Segregates volumes by b0 threshold
538	    b0_idx = np.argwhere(bvals <= b0_threshold)
539	    dwi_idx = np.argwhere(bvals > b0_threshold)
540	
541	    data_b0s = np.squeeze(np.take(data, b0_idx, axis=3))
542	    data_dwi = np.squeeze(np.take(data, dwi_idx, axis=3))
543	
544	    # create empty arrays
545	    denoised_b0s = np.empty(data_b0s.shape, dtype=calc_dtype)
546	    denoised_dwi = np.empty(data_dwi.shape, dtype=calc_dtype)
547	
548	    denoised_arr = np.empty(data.shape, dtype=calc_dtype)
549	
550	    if verbose is True:
551	        t1 = time.time()
552	
553	    # if only 1 b0 volume, skip denoising it
554	    if data_b0s.ndim == 3 or not b0_denoising:
555	        if verbose:
556	            logger.info("b0 denoising skipped...")
557	        denoised_b0s = data_b0s
558	
559	    else:
560	        train_b0 = _extract_3d_patches(
561	            np.pad(
562	                data_b0s,
563	                (
564	                    (patch_radius[0], patch_radius[0]),
565	                    (patch_radius[1], patch_radius[1]),
566	                    (patch_radius[2], patch_radius[2]),
567	                    (0, 0),
568	                ),
569	                mode="constant",
570	            ),
571	            patch_radius=patch_radius,
572	        )
573	
574	        for vol_idx in range(0, data_b0s.shape[3]):
575	            b0_model, cur_x = _fit_denoising_model(
576	                train_b0, vol_idx, model, alpha=alpha
577	            )
578	
579	            denoised_b0s[..., vol_idx] = b0_model.predict(cur_x.T).reshape(
580	                data_b0s.shape[0], data_b0s.shape[1], data_b0s.shape[2]
581	            )
582	
583	        if verbose is True:
584	            logger.info(f"Denoised b0 Volume: {vol_idx}")
585	    # Separate denoising for DWI volumes
586	    train_dwi = _extract_3d_patches(
587	        np.pad(
588	            data_dwi,
589	            (
590	                (patch_radius[0], patch_radius[0]),
591	                (patch_radius[1], patch_radius[1]),
592	                (patch_radius[2], patch_radius[2]),
593	                (0, 0),
594	            ),
595	            mode="constant",
596	        ),
597	        patch_radius=patch_radius,
598	    )
599	
600	    # Insert the separately denoised arrays into the respective empty arrays
601	    for vol_idx in range(0, data_dwi.shape[3]):
602	        dwi_model, cur_x = _fit_denoising_model(train_dwi, vol_idx, model, alpha=alpha)
603	        denoised_dwi[..., vol_idx] = dwi_model.predict(cur_x.T).reshape(
604	            data_dwi.shape[0], data_dwi.shape[1], data_dwi.shape[2]
605	        )
606	
607	        if verbose is True:
608	            logger.info(f"Denoised DWI Volume: {vol_idx}")
609	
610	    if verbose is True:
611	        t2 = time.time()
612	        logger.info(f"Total time taken for Patch2Self: {t2 - t1:.3f} seconds")
613	
614	    if data_b0s.ndim == 3:
615	        denoised_arr[:, :, :, b0_idx[0][0]] = denoised_b0s
616	    else:
617	        for i, idx in enumerate(b0_idx):
618	            denoised_arr[:, :, :, idx[0]] = np.squeeze(denoised_b0s[..., i])
619	
620	    for i, idx in enumerate(dwi_idx):
621	        denoised_arr[:, :, :, idx[0]] = np.squeeze(denoised_dwi[..., i])
622	
623	    if 1 in original_shape and original_shape[-1] != 1:
624	        denoised_arr = np.take(denoised_arr, [0], axis=position)
625	
626	    denoised_arr = _apply_post_processing(
627	        denoised_arr, shift_intensity, clip_negative_vals
628	    )
629	    return np.array(denoised_arr, dtype=out_dtype)

import sys
import warnings

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/task/source")
from dipy.denoise.patch2self import patch2self


def make_case(rng_seed, shape, levels, b0_vols=(), corner=None):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(rng_seed)
    data = np.empty(shape, np.float32)
    for k, lv in enumerate(levels):
        data[..., k] = lv + 0.01 * rng.standard_normal(shape[:3])
    if corner is not None:
        dz, dy, dx, boost, start = corner
        data[:dz, :dy, :dx, start:] += boost
    bvals = np.array([0.0 if k in b0_vols else 1000.0 for k in range(shape[-1])])
    return data, bvals


def check(name, data, expected_means, out, tol=0.5):
    assert isinstance(out, np.ndarray), name
    assert out.shape == data.shape, (name, out.shape)
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(out)), name
    means = out.mean(axis=(0, 1, 2))
    dev = np.abs(means - np.asarray(expected_means)).max()
    status = "OK " if dev < tol else "MISMATCH"
    print(f"{status} {name}: max dev from expected means = {dev:.3f}")
    return dev < tol


results = []

# 1) volume counts across all mod-5 remainders (v3 workhorse), 10..14, plus small
for nv in [5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 17, 23]:
    levels = [10.0 + 2.0 * k for k in range(nv)]
    data, bvals = make_case(
        100 + nv, (6, 6, 6, nv), levels, corner=(3, 3, 3, 40.0, nv // 3)
    )
    exp = [lv + (5.0 if k >= nv // 3 else 0.0) for k, lv in enumerate(levels)]
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
    results.append(check(f"v3 nv={nv}", data, exp, out))

# 2) single b0 at the END, b0 passthrough (b0 denoising auto-skipped)
nv = 13
levels = [200.0 + 10 * k for k in range(nv - 1)] + [1000.0]
data, bvals = make_case(5, (5, 5, 5, nv), levels, b0_vols=(nv - 1,))
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                 shift_intensity=False)
results.append(check("v3 single trailing b0 (skip)", data, levels, out, tol=2.0))

# 3) interleaved b0 volumes, b0_denoising=True
nv = 15
b0s = (0, 7, 14)
levels = [600.0 if k in b0s else 200.0 + 5 * k for k in range(nv)]
data, bvals = make_case(6, (6, 6, 6, nv), levels, b0_vols=b0s)
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ridge", version=3, verbose=False,
                 shift_intensity=False, b0_denoising=True)
results.append(check("v3 interleaved b0s denoised", data, levels, out, tol=5.0))

# 4) same interleaved case with b0_denoising=False (passthrough must be exact)
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False, b0_denoising=False)
for k in b0s:
    exact = np.allclose(out[..., k], data[..., k])
    print(f"OK  v3 passthrough b0 idx {k} exact: {exact}" if exact
          else f"MISMATCH v3 passthrough b0 idx {k}")
    results.append(exact)

# 5) post-processing: shift_intensity guarantees non-negative, preserves mins
out_shift = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                       shift_intensity=True)
mn = [out_shift[..., i].min() for i in range(nv)]
ok = np.all(np.isfinite(out_shift)) and all(abs(m) < 1e-3 for m in mn)
print(("OK " if ok else "MISMATCH") + f" v3 shift_intensity -> per-vol min ~0 ({min(mn):.2e},{max(mn):.2e})")
results.append(ok)

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
    out_clip = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                          shift_intensity=False, clip_negative_vals=True)
ok = np.all(np.isfinite(out_clip)) and out_clip.min() >= 0
print(("OK " if ok else "MISMATCH") + " v3 clip_negative_vals -> >= 0")
results.append(ok)

# 6) custom sklearn models as objects
from sklearn.linear_model import Lasso, LinearRegression, Ridge

for mdl in [LinearRegression(), Ridge(alpha=1.0), Lasso(alpha=0.1, max_iter=50)]:
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model=mdl, version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
    ok = isinstance(out, np.ndarray) and out.shape == data.shape and np.all(np.isfinite(out))
    print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL") + f" custom model {type(mdl).__name__}")
    results.append(ok)

# also strings ridge/lasso on version 1
for mname in ["ols", "ridge", "lasso"]:
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model=mname, version=1, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
    results.append(check(f"v1 model={mname}", data, levels, out, tol=6.0))

# 7) version 1 with patch radius
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=1, patch_radius=1,
                 verbose=False, shift_intensity=False)
results.append(check("v1 patch_radius=1", data, levels, out, tol=6.0))

# 8) float64 input keeps precision and stays finite
out = patch2self(data.astype(np.float64), bvals, model="ols", version=3,
                 verbose=False, shift_intensity=False)
ok = out.dtype == np.float64 and np.all(np.isfinite(out))
print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL") + " float64 in/out")
results.append(ok)

# 9) tiny spatial data (guards in count_sketch / chunk steps)
levels = [100.0 + k for k in range(10)]
data, bvals = make_case(9, (3, 3, 3, 10), levels)
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                 shift_intensity=False)
results.append(check("v3 tiny 3x3x3", data, levels, out, tol=1.0))

data, bvals = make_case(10, (2, 2, 2, 10), levels)
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                 shift_intensity=False)
results.append(check("v3 tiny 2x2x2", data, levels, out, tol=1.0))

# 10) fewer than 10 volumes warns but completes
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    data, bvals = make_case(11, (5, 5, 5, 8), levels[:8])
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
ok = any("less than 10" in str(x.message) for x in w) and np.all(np.isfinite(out))
print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL") + " <10 volumes warns + completes")
results.append(ok)

print("\n%d/%d checks passed" % (sum(results), len(results)))
sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)

import sys
import warnings

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/task/source")
from dipy.denoise.patch2self import patch2self


def make_case(rng_seed, shape, levels, b0_vols=(), corner=None):
    """Synthetic DWI-like data: per-volume level with zero-mean spatial
    structure (so regression design is well conditioned and volume means
    equal the levels), plus low noise."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(rng_seed)
    g = np.linspace(-0.5, 0.5, int(np.prod(shape[:3]))).reshape(shape[:3])
    g = g - g.mean()
    data = np.empty(shape, np.float32)
    for k, lv in enumerate(levels):
        data[..., k] = lv * (1 + 0.3 * g) + 0.005 * lv * rng.standard_normal(shape[:3])
    if corner is not None:
        dz, dy, dx, boost, start = corner
        data[:dz, :dy, :dx, start:] += boost
    bvals = np.array([0.0 if k in b0_vols else 1000.0 for k in range(shape[-1])])
    return data, bvals


def check(name, data, expected_means, out, tol=3.0):
    assert isinstance(out, np.ndarray), name
    assert out.shape == data.shape, (name, out.shape)
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(out)), name
    means = out.mean(axis=(0, 1, 2))
    dev = np.abs(means - np.asarray(expected_means)).max()
    status = "OK " if dev < tol else "MISMATCH"
    print(f"{status} {name}: max dev = {dev:.3f}")
    return dev < tol


results = []

# 1) v3 across volume counts (all mod-5 remainders + small)
for nv in [5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 17, 23]:
    levels = [10.0 + 2.0 * k for k in range(nv)]
    data, bvals = make_case(
        100 + nv, (6, 6, 6, nv), levels, corner=(3, 3, 3, 40.0, nv // 3)
    )
    exp = [lv + (5.0 if k >= nv // 3 else 0.0) for k, lv in enumerate(levels)]
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
    results.append(check(f"v3 nv={nv}", data, exp, out))

# 2) v1 and v3 agreement across model strings on a varied case
nv = 14
b0s = (0, 7, 13)
levels = [600.0 if k in b0s else 200.0 + 5 * k for k in range(nv)]
data, bvals = make_case(6, (6, 6, 6, nv), levels, b0_vols=b0s)
for ver in [1, 3]:
    for mname in ["ols", "ridge", "lasso"]:
        kwargs = dict(model=mname, version=ver, verbose=False, shift_intensity=False)
        if ver == 1:
            kwargs["tmp_dir"] = None
        out = patch2self(data, bvals, **kwargs)
        results.append(check(f"v{ver} model={mname}", data, levels, out, tol=5.0))

# 3) v1 with patch radius
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=1, patch_radius=1,
                 verbose=False, shift_intensity=False)
results.append(check("v1 patch_radius=1", data, levels, out, tol=5.0))

# 4) single b0 at the END, b0 passthrough (auto-skip)
nv = 13
levels = [200.0 + 10 * k for k in range(nv - 1)] + [1000.0]
data, bvals = make_case(5, (5, 5, 5, nv), levels, b0_vols=(nv - 1,))
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                 shift_intensity=False)
results.append(check("v3 single trailing b0 skip", data, levels, out, tol=6.0))

# 5) b0_denoising=False passthrough must be EXACT, even interleaved
nv = 15
b0s = (0, 7, 14)
levels = [600.0 if k in b0s else 200.0 + 5 * k for k in range(nv)]
data, bvals = make_case(6, (6, 6, 6, nv), levels, b0_vols=b0s)
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                 shift_intensity=False, b0_denoising=False)
for k in b0s:
    exact = np.allclose(out[..., k], data[..., k])
    print(("OK " if exact else "MISMATCH ") + f"v3 passthrough b0 idx {k} exact: {exact}")
    results.append(exact)

# 6) post-processing semantics
out_shift = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                       shift_intensity=True)
mn = [out_shift[..., i].min() for i in range(nv)]
ok = np.all(np.isfinite(out_shift)) and all(abs(m) < 1e-3 for m in mn)
print(("OK " if ok else "MISMATCH") + " v3 shift_intensity -> per-vol min == 0")
results.append(ok)

with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
    out_clip = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                          shift_intensity=False, clip_negative_vals=True)
ok = np.all(np.isfinite(out_clip)) and out_clip.min() >= 0
print(("OK " if ok else "MISMATCH") + " v3 clip_negative_vals -> >= 0")
results.append(ok)

# 7) custom sklearn model objects
from sklearn.linear_model import Lasso, LinearRegression, Ridge

for mdl in [LinearRegression(), Ridge(alpha=1.0), Lasso(alpha=0.1, max_iter=50)]:
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model=mdl, version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
    ok = isinstance(out, np.ndarray) and out.shape == data.shape and np.all(np.isfinite(out))
    print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL ") + f"v3 custom model {type(mdl).__name__}")
    results.append(ok)
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model=mdl, version=1, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
    results.append(check(f"v1 custom {type(mdl).__name__}", data, levels, out, tol=6.0))

# 8) string and equivalent object models agree in v1 (no estimator-side mutation)
a = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=1, verbose=False, shift_intensity=False)
b = patch2self(data, bvals, model=Ridge(alpha=1e-10), version=1, verbose=False,
               shift_intensity=False)
ok = np.allclose(a, b, atol=1e-3)
print(("OK " if ok else "MISMATCH ") + "v1 'ols' == Ridge(alpha=1e-10) object")
results.append(ok)

# 9) float64 preserved
out = patch2self(data.astype(np.float64), bvals, model="ols", version=3,
                 verbose=False, shift_intensity=False)
ok = out.dtype == np.float64 and np.all(np.isfinite(out))
print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL ") + "float64 in/out")
results.append(ok)

# 10) tiny spatial volumes exercise chunk guards
levels = [100.0 + k for k in range(10)]
for side in [3, 2]:
    data, bvals = make_case(9 + side, (side, side, side, 10), levels)
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
    results.append(check(f"v3 tiny {side}x{side}x{side}", data, levels, out, tol=3.0))

# 11) < 10 volumes: warns but completes
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    data, bvals = make_case(11, (5, 5, 5, 8), levels[:8])
    out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=3, verbose=False,
                     shift_intensity=False)
ok = any("less than 10" in str(x.message) for x in w) and np.all(np.isfinite(out))
print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL ") + "<10 volumes warns + completes")
results.append(ok)

# 12) degenerate singleton spatial axis handled (v1 duplicates internally)
data, bvals = make_case(12, (1, 6, 6, 10), levels)
out = patch2self(data, bvals, model="ols", version=1, verbose=False,
                 shift_intensity=False)
ok = out.shape == data.shape and np.all(np.isfinite(out))
print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL ") + "v1 singleton axis")
results.append(ok)

print("\n%d/%d checks passed" % (sum(results), len(results)))
sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)
